name: mindsai-personas
description: Build AI knowledge bases, run multi-perspective research panels, and export branded reports. Train AI on topics, documents, or websites. Survey synthetic expert groups for market research and policy testing.
author: Minds AI

tools.name: list_my_ai_personas
tools.description: List all your AI knowledge bases with optional fuzzy search

tools.name: create_ai_persona_or_digital_twin
tools.description: Create an AI knowledge base trained on topics, people, or websites

tools.name: talk_to_ai_persona
tools.description: Chat with an AI knowledge base and get expert analysis

tools.name: check_ai_persona_training_progress
tools.description: Check the training status of an AI knowledge base

tools.name: create_panel
tools.description: Create a research panel with groups of AI knowledge bases for comparative analysis

tools.name: ask_panel
tools.description: Submit a research question to a panel — responses streamed in real-time with cross-group comparison

tools.name: list_panels
tools.description: List all research panels with group composition and message counts

tools.name: get_panel_status
tools.description: Get detailed panel info including groups, messages, and export status

tools.name: get_panel_analytics
tools.description: Compute statistics for panel questions — mean, distribution, themes, divergence

tools.name: export_panel
tools.description: Export panel results as markdown, branded PDF, or JSON data

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List knowledge base groups with member details

resources.name: ai-persona-widget
resources.description: Interactive widget for creating and chatting with AI personas
